blocks.title: Graph
blocks.text: Graph vertices (nodes) ka majmooa hai jo edges se jure hain, aur rabton ke networks dikhane ke liye istemal hota hai. Vertices shehar, log ya khayalat ho sakte hain; edges un ke darmiyan rishte ya raaste hain.

Pakistan ke shehron aur unhein jorne wali sarkon ka naqsha graph banata hai: har shehar vertex aur har sarak edge. Social network mein har shakhs bohat se doosron se jur sakta hai. Tree graph ki khaas qism hai: tree ki ek jarr aur kinhi do nodes ke darmiyan bilkul ek raasta hota hai, to cycles nahi, jabke graph ki jarr zaroori nahi aur kai raaste aur cycles ho sakte hain. Trees family trees jaise munazzam data ke liye; graphs networks, web links aur transport systems ke liye munasib hain.

blocks.prompt: Tree aur graph mein do farq bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Tree ki ek jarr aur darja-bandi hai, graph ki zaroori nahi; tree mein do nodes ke darmiyan bilkul ek raasta aur koi cycle nahi, graph mein kai raaste aur cycles ho sakte hain.

items: Graph: edges se jure vertices; ek jarr nahi; cycles ki ijazat; tree khaas graph hai.
